_comment: A stand-in for persona/prompts.json, which is kept out of the repository. Every key the code reads is listed here with a one-line placeholder, so a fresh checkout runs; the wording that ships with the real character is private.
spoken_delivery: Placeholder. Travels with every turn: the reply is spoken aloud, so keep it to a sentence or two and use no markup.
portuguese_instruction: Placeholder. Added to the turn when the user has asked for another language: answer in that language, in the same character.
decider_system: Placeholder. A separate, non-answering pass that decides what to look up or remember first; it is given the tool list at runtime and calls nothing for ordinary chat.

clock_instruction.en: Current local date and time: {date}. This is current and correct. If {owner} asks only for the time, reply only: '{clock}' and nothing else.

guru_not_found.en: I can't find him talking about that.
guru_not_found.pt: Não encontrei ele falando sobre isso.

guru_unreachable.en: I can't reach his videos just now.
guru_unreachable.pt: Não consigo acessar os vídeos dele agora.

media_no_match.en: I couldn't find anything by that name.
media_no_match.pt: Não encontrei nada com esse nome.

media_last.en: That was the last of them.

youtube_unreachable.en: I can't reach YouTube just now.
youtube_unreachable.pt: Não consigo acessar o YouTube agora.
